_comment: Themes: each one traces specific Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek words, never hand-picked verses, so every highlighted verse can be checked against the original text.
groups: the plain-named rows the theme list folds into, in display order ({id, name}). Every group must be used by at least one theme.
featured: the theme ids shown first as 'Start with' cards. Each must exist and show at the Simple level.

links: the rule for reaching a theme through a verse's links when the verse's own words carry none. Take the verse's `top` strongest cross-references with at least `votes` votes (both directions, the best votes per pair); a theme counts when `carriers` of those linked verses carry it, or one linked verse whose link has `soloVotes` or more; themes of more than `maxThemeSize` verses are skipped, and so is a theme one of whose `exclude`d senses occurs in the verse. The build copies these numbers to meta.json (themeLinks) for the app and atlas verify.

near: the rule for 'Often linked with'. Over the distinct verse pairs joined by a cross-reference with at least `votes` votes, count the pairs with one end in each theme; a partner needs `minLinks` such pairs and a lift of `minLift` (pairs over the count expected by chance), ranked by pairs times ln(lift), at most `max` per theme. Copied to meta.json (themeNear).

Per theme: `id` names the theme in shared links (#t=lamb), so ids never change and new themes are only ever appended. `name` and `blurb` are plain words; the blurb may only paraphrase verses the theme lights, starting with its key verses.
`group`: one of the groups above. `level`: "study" for a broad word that mostly lights ordinary narrative (genealogies, court stories, counts), shown from the Study level up; leave it out for Simple.
`key_verses`: 2 or 3 references the blurb rests on. atlas build fails unless each one resolves to a single verse that the theme lights, and atlas verify checks them again.

`roots`: `strong` is a Strong's number, optionally with one STEPBible sub-entry letter (H2022G is the mountain sense, not H2022H hill country); every sub-entry of it whose Tyndale lexicon gloss contains one of `match` is included. Match strings are lowercase, because glosses are compared in lowercase.
Glosses that start with a capital letter belong to names and places and are skipped, unless `capitalized` is true (for roots whose own gloss is capitalized, such as Passover, Christ or Jerusalem).

`exclude` lists sub-entries deliberately left out although their gloss matches (seed: semen, sea: west). The app shows them as 'Left out', and the links rule never offers the theme on a verse that contains one of them.

`skip_with`: Strong's numbers (with or without a sub-entry letter) that take a verse out of the theme when they occur in it. Seven and Forty use it for hundred and thousand, where the number is part of a count (Ezra 2:3 '2,172'), not a picture.

atlas build fails if a root matches nothing, if an exclude names a sub-entry the root would not include, or if a group, featured id, level, skip_with key or key verse is wrong, so a typo cannot silently empty or change a theme. `atlas themes-review --group <id>` prints each theme's words, leave-outs, size and sample verses for review.

themes.name: Lamb
themes.blurb: From Abel's flock and the Passover to the Lamb on the throne.

themes.name: Light
themes.blurb: The first words of creation, the lamp of the law, the light of the world.

themes.name: Shepherd
themes.blurb: Shepherding as the picture of leading, feeding and protecting a people.

themes.name: Vine and vineyard
themes.blurb: Israel as a planted vine, the vineyard song, the true vine.

themes.name: Bread
themes.blurb: Daily bread, manna, the bread of the presence, the bread of life.

themes.name: Water
themes.blurb: The deep at creation, water from the rock, living water.

themes.name: Rock
themes.blurb: God as a rock and refuge, the rock in the wilderness, the house on the rock.

themes.name: Fire
themes.blurb: The burning bush, the pillar of fire, refining fire, tongues of fire.

themes.name: Blood
themes.blurb: Life is in the blood: sacrifice, covenant and the cup.

themes.name: Covenant
themes.blurb: Noah, Abraham, Sinai, David, and the new covenant.

themes.name: Seed and offspring
themes.blurb: The promised offspring, from Genesis 3 to Galatians 3.

themes.name: Bride and bridegroom
themes.blurb: Marriage as the picture of God and his people. The Hebrew word for bridegroom, חָתָן, also means son-in-law.

themes.name: Temple and tabernacle
themes.blurb: Where God dwells with people: tent, temple, body, city.

themes.name: Tree
themes.blurb: The tree of life, the cursed tree, the leaves for healing.

themes.name: The way
themes.blurb: Walking in the way, the two ways, the way prepared in the wilderness.

themes.name: Spirit, wind and breath
themes.blurb: One word in Hebrew and one in Greek carry all three meanings.

themes.name: Passover
themes.blurb: From the night of the LORD’s Passover in Egypt to Christ, our Passover lamb.

themes.name: Redeemer
themes.blurb: From the kinsman-redeemer of Ruth to a ransom for many.

themes.name: Atonement and the mercy seat
themes.blurb: From the mercy seat to the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

themes.name: The Anointed One
themes.blurb: Anointed priests and kings, and the Messiah, which is translated as Christ.

themes.name: Sabbath rest
themes.blurb: The seventh day of rest, and a Sabbath rest for the people of God (the Greek word also means week).

themes.name: The kingdom
themes.blurb: The kingdoms of the earth, and a kingdom that will never be destroyed (one Hebrew word for it also means reign or royalty).

themes.name: Firstborn
themes.blurb: Israel, the LORD’s firstborn son, and the firstborn over all creation.

themes.name: Darkness
themes.blurb: Darkness over the deep, a people walking in darkness, and a light the darkness has not overcome.

themes.name: Mountains
themes.blurb: Ararat, Moriah, Sinai, Zion, Carmel, the mount of the sermon and of the Transfiguration.

themes.name: The sea
themes.blurb: The gathered waters called seas, the sea divided for Israel, Jonah and the storm, and the sea that was no more.

themes.name: Rivers
themes.blurb: The river out of Eden, streams in the desert, the river of the water of life.

themes.name: Wilderness
themes.blurb: Forty years in the wilderness, a voice calling in it, forty days of testing.

themes.name: Garden
themes.blurb: Eden, the garden of the Song, a garden where Jesus was arrested and a garden tomb, and paradise.

themes.name: Cup
themes.blurb: My cup overflows, the cup of wrath, the cup of the new covenant.

themes.name: Oil and anointing
themes.blurb: Oil poured on priests, kings and the sick: the root of the word Messiah.

themes.name: Wine
themes.blurb: Wine that gladdens the heart, the wedding at Cana, new wine in new wineskins.

themes.name: Doors and gates
themes.blurb: The gate of heaven at Bethel, the gates of righteousness, I am the gate.

themes.name: Stars
themes.blurb: Offspring as many as the stars, a star out of Jacob, the bright morning star.

themes.name: Sun and moon
themes.blurb: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night; the sun of righteousness; a city with no need of sun or moon.

themes.name: Cloud
themes.blurb: The pillar of cloud, the glory filling the temple, the Son of Man coming on the clouds.

themes.name: Rain and dew
themes.blurb: Rain in its season, the dew of Hermon, teaching that falls like rain.

themes.name: Harvest
themes.blurb: Seedtime and harvest, Ruth in the fields, the harvest is plentiful.

themes.name: Fruit
themes.blurb: Be fruitful and multiply, a tree is known by its fruit, the fruit of the Spirit.

themes.name: Sheep and flock
themes.blurb: Abel and the patriarchs with their flocks, sheep gone astray, one flock and one shepherd.

themes.name: Lion
themes.blurb: Judah a young lion, the lion eating straw like the ox, the Lion of the tribe of Judah.

themes.name: Wings
themes.blurb: Carried on eagles’ wings, refuge under his wings, healing in its wings. The Hebrew word for wing is also the corner of a garment (Ruth 3:9).

themes.name: Dove
themes.blurb: Noah’s dove with an olive leaf, the dove of the Song, the Spirit descending like a dove.

themes.name: Serpent and dragon
themes.blurb: The serpent in the garden, the bronze snake, the dragon of Revelation.

themes.name: Throne
themes.blurb: David’s throne forever, a throne high and exalted, the throne of grace.

themes.name: Crown
themes.blurb: A crown of pure gold, a crown of thorns, the crown of life.

themes.name: Sword
themes.blurb: The flaming sword at Eden, swords into plowshares, the sword of the Spirit.

themes.name: Refuge and shield
themes.blurb: God as refuge, fortress and shield; the cities of refuge.

themes.name: Horn
themes.blurb: Horns of the altar, a horn of salvation, the horns of Daniel and Revelation.

themes.name: Arm
themes.blurb: An outstretched arm brought Israel out of Egypt; to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?

themes.name: Heart
themes.blurb: Love the LORD with all your heart, a new heart, the pure in heart.

themes.name: The name
themes.blurb: Call on the name of the LORD, hallowed be your name, the name above all names.

themes.name: The word
themes.blurb: The word of the LORD came, your word is a lamp, in the beginning was the Word.

themes.name: Voice
themes.blurb: The voice of the LORD over the waters, a voice in the wilderness, my sheep listen to my voice.

themes.name: Book and scroll
themes.blurb: The book of the law, the scroll Jesus read, the Lamb’s book of life.

themes.name: Table
themes.blurb: A table prepared before me, the table of the presence, the Lord’s table.

themes.name: Yoke
themes.blurb: The yoke of slavery broken, and my yoke is easy.

themes.name: Robes and clothing
themes.blurb: Garments of skin, Joseph’s robe, garments of salvation, clothes as white as the light.

themes.name: Stone
themes.blurb: Jacob’s pillow, tablets of stone, a heart of stone, the stone the builders rejected.

themes.name: Dust
themes.blurb: Formed from the dust and returning to it, offspring like the dust, raised from the dust.

themes.name: Grass and flowers
themes.blurb: All flesh is like grass, its glory like the flowers of the field; God clothes the grass of the field.

themes.name: Leaven and unleavened bread
themes.blurb: Bread made in haste at the Passover, and the leaven that works through all the flour.

themes.name: Milk and honey
themes.blurb: A land flowing with milk and honey, sweeter than honey, pure spiritual milk.

themes.name: Fig tree and olive
themes.blurb: Fig leaves in Eden, everyone under their own vine and fig tree, the olive tree of Romans 11.

themes.name: Trumpet
themes.blurb: The ram’s horn at Sinai and at Jericho, the year of Jubilee, the last trumpet.

themes.name: The ark
themes.blurb: Noah’s ark and the ark of the covenant: two Hebrew words, one Greek word for both.

themes.name: Lamp and lampstand
themes.blurb: The golden lampstand, your word is a lamp to my feet, a lamp on a stand.

themes.name: Fish and nets
themes.blurb: Jonah’s great fish, fishers of men, the net full of fish.

themes.name: Potter and clay
themes.blurb: The Hebrew word for potter means one who forms: God formed Adam from the dust; we are the clay.

themes.name: Foundation
themes.blurb: The foundations of the earth, a tested cornerstone laid in Zion, the house built on rock.

themes.name: Root and branch
themes.blurb: A shoot from the stump of Jesse, a Branch from his roots, I am the vine, you are the branches.

themes.name: Grain and wheat
themes.blurb: Grain, new wine and oil; the wheat gathered into the barn; a kernel of wheat that falls and dies.

themes.name: Silver and gold
themes.blurb: Gold of the tabernacle, refined like silver, thirty pieces of silver, a street of pure gold.

themes.name: Right hand
themes.blurb: Sit at my right hand, a line the New Testament comes back to again and again; at your right hand are pleasures forever.

themes.name: Face
themes.blurb: The LORD make his face shine on you, seek my face, face to face. The Hebrew word for face is also used for presence.

themes.name: Morning
themes.blurb: Evening and morning, joy comes in the morning, mercies new every morning, early on the first day.

themes.name: Love
themes.blurb: Love the LORD your God, love your neighbor, God so loved the world, God is love.

themes.name: Loving devotion
themes.blurb: The Hebrew chesed, which the BSB calls loving devotion: abounding in loving devotion, his loving devotion endures forever, because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed.

themes.name: Mercy and compassion
themes.blurb: The LORD, compassionate and gracious; have mercy on me; moved with compassion for the crowds.

themes.name: Grace and favor
themes.blurb: Noah found favor, the LORD be gracious to you, by grace you have been saved.

themes.name: Truth and faithfulness
themes.blurb: Abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness, great is your faithfulness, the way, the truth and the life.

themes.name: Salvation
themes.blurb: The LORD is my light and my salvation; you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people.

themes.name: Peace
themes.blurb: Shalom: the LORD give you peace, the Prince of Peace, peace I leave with you.

themes.name: Hope and waiting
themes.blurb: Those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; a future and a hope; hope does not disappoint.

themes.name: Joy
themes.blurb: You will fill me with joy in your presence, good news of great joy, rejoice in the Lord always.

themes.name: Life
themes.blurb: The breath of life, choose life, the bread of life, eternal life.

themes.name: Forever
themes.blurb: An everlasting covenant, his loving devotion endures forever, eternal life.

themes.name: Glory
themes.blurb: The glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle; we have seen his glory.

themes.name: Holy
themes.blurb: Take off your sandals, this is holy ground; be holy, because I am holy; holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts.

themes.name: Righteousness
themes.blurb: Abram believed and it was credited as righteousness; the righteous will live by faith.

themes.name: Justice and judgment
themes.blurb: Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right? Let justice roll on like a river.

themes.name: Forgiveness
themes.blurb: He forgives all your iniquities, forgive us our debts, the forgiveness of sins.

themes.name: Promise and oath
themes.blurb: By myself I have sworn, the promise to Abraham, God guaranteed it with an oath.

themes.name: Blessing
themes.blurb: All nations blessed in Abraham, the LORD bless you and keep you, blessed are the poor in spirit.

themes.name: Inheritance
themes.blurb: The land as Israel’s inheritance, the LORD as Levi’s, heirs of God.

themes.name: Healing
themes.blurb: I am the LORD who heals you; by his stripes we are healed; he healed them all.

themes.name: Rising from the dead
themes.blurb: The Greek word for resurrection, from the question put to Jesus about the seven brothers to the hope Paul writes about.

themes.name: New
themes.blurb: A new song, a new heart, a new covenant, new heavens and a new earth.

themes.name: Wisdom
themes.blurb: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; Christ the wisdom of God.

themes.name: Comfort
themes.blurb: Comfort, comfort my people; your rod and your staff, they comfort me; the God of all comfort.

themes.name: Freedom
themes.blurb: Proclaim liberty in the land; the truth will set you free.

themes.name: Good news
themes.blurb: How beautiful the feet of those who bring good news; the gospel of the kingdom.

themes.name: Servant
themes.blurb: Moses my servant, my righteous Servant in Isaiah, Christ taking the form of a servant.

themes.name: Priest
themes.blurb: Melchizedek, Aaron and his sons, a kingdom of priests, a great high priest.

themes.name: Prophet
themes.blurb: A prophet like Moses, the prophets who spoke of the coming one, and a prophet from Nazareth.

themes.name: King
themes.blurb: Kings of Israel and Judah, your king comes to you, King of kings.

themes.name: Father
themes.blurb: Abraham, father of many nations, a father of the fatherless, our Father in heaven.

themes.name: Son
themes.blurb: Sons in every family line; you are my Son; a son is given; the Son of God.

themes.name: Widows and orphans
themes.blurb: God defends the fatherless and the widow; the widow’s offering.

themes.name: Strangers and foreigners
themes.blurb: You were foreigners in Egypt; Ruth the foreigner; no longer strangers and foreigners.

themes.name: The poor and needy
themes.blurb: He raises the poor from the dust; good news to the poor.

themes.name: Teaching and learning
themes.blurb: Teach them to your children; learn from me; teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you.

themes.name: Angels and messengers
themes.blurb: The angel of the LORD, I send my messenger, the angels at the tomb. One word in Hebrew and one in Greek mean both.

themes.name: Enemies
themes.blurb: Deliver me from my enemies; love your enemies; the last enemy is death.

themes.name: The nations
themes.blurb: All nations blessed through Abraham, a light for the nations, make disciples of all nations.

themes.name: Neighbors and friends
themes.blurb: Love your neighbor as yourself; who is my neighbor? You are my friends.

themes.name: Witness and testimony
themes.blurb: The ark of the testimony, you are my witnesses, you will be my witnesses.

themes.name: Remnant
themes.blurb: A remnant will return; a remnant chosen by grace.

themes.name: Creation
themes.blurb: In the beginning God created; create in me a clean heart; a new creation.

themes.name: Chosen
themes.blurb: The LORD chose Abram, Israel and David; a chosen people; chosen before the foundation of the world.

themes.name: Remember
themes.blurb: God remembered Noah, remember the Sabbath, Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom.

themes.name: Rescue
themes.blurb: I have come down to rescue them; deliver us from the evil one.

themes.name: Scattered and gathered
themes.blurb: Scattered at Babel and among the nations, then gathered again; strike the shepherd and the sheep will be scattered.

themes.name: Exile
themes.blurb: Carried away to Assyria and Babylon, and brought back; the exile in Matthew’s family line.

themes.name: Anger and wrath
themes.blurb: Slow to anger, the cup of his fury, rescued from the coming wrath.

themes.name: Revealed
themes.blurb: The secret things belong to the LORD but the things revealed belong to us; the glory of the LORD revealed; the revelation of Jesus Christ.

themes.name: Faith and trust
themes.blurb: Abram believed the LORD; trust in the LORD with all your heart; whoever believes in him.

themes.name: Turning back
themes.blurb: Repent and live; let the wicked return to the LORD; repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.

themes.name: Prayer
themes.blurb: Hannah’s prayer, Solomon’s prayer, a house of prayer, teach us to pray.

themes.name: Praise and thanks
themes.blurb: Give thanks to the LORD for he is good; praise the LORD; give thanks in every circumstance.

themes.name: Worship
themes.blurb: Abraham went to worship, come let us worship and bow down, worship in spirit and truth. The Hebrew word means to bow down.

themes.name: Songs
themes.blurb: The song of Moses, sing to the LORD a new song, psalms, hymns and spiritual songs.

themes.name: Fear and awe
themes.blurb: The same words mean being afraid and standing in awe: do not be afraid, and the fear of the LORD.

themes.name: Listening and obeying
themes.blurb: The Hebrew for obey is to hear: obedience is better than sacrifice; he learned obedience from what he suffered.

themes.name: Tears and mourning
themes.blurb: Those who sow in tears, Jesus wept, he will wipe away every tear.

themes.name: Fasting
themes.blurb: Esther’s fast, the fast the LORD chooses, forty days in the wilderness.

themes.name: Sacrifice and offering
themes.blurb: Abel’s offering, the burnt offering on Moriah, a living sacrifice, one sacrifice for sins forever.

themes.name: Altar
themes.blurb: Noah’s altar, Abraham’s altars, the altar of the tabernacle, and the altar before the throne.

themes.name: Incense
themes.blurb: The altar of incense, my prayer set before you like incense, and incense rising with the prayers of the saints.

themes.name: Washing and baptism
themes.blurb: Naaman told to wash seven times in the Jordan; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow; baptized in the Jordan River.

themes.name: Clean and unclean
themes.blurb: Laws of clean and unclean, create in me a clean heart, what God has made clean.

themes.name: Law and commandments
themes.blurb: Those who love me and keep my commandments, his delight is in the law of the LORD, the greatest commandment.

themes.name: The cross
themes.blurb: The Greek words for the cross and for crucifying, from the Gospels to Paul and Revelation.

themes.name: Sin
themes.blurb: Sin crouching at the door, transgressions and iniquities, the Lamb who takes away the sin of the world.

themes.name: Death
themes.blurb: You will surely die, he will swallow up death forever, where, O Death, is your sting?

themes.name: The grave
themes.blurb: Sheol in Hebrew, Hades and Gehenna in Greek: you will not abandon my soul to Sheol.

themes.name: Idols
themes.blurb: Their idols are silver and gold, a land full of idols, keep yourselves from idols.

themes.name: Pride and humility
themes.blurb: Pride goes before destruction; he humbled himself; God opposes the proud.

themes.name: Satan
themes.blurb: The Hebrew satan means adversary: human enemies, the angel who stood in Balaam’s way, the accuser in Job; then the tempter and the devil defeated.

themes.name: Unfaithfulness
themes.blurb: Unfaithfulness in marriage as the prophets’ picture of turning from God, in Hosea, Ezekiel and Revelation.

themes.name: Blind and seeing
themes.blurb: The eyes of the blind opened, I was blind but now I see.

themes.name: Hunger and thirst
themes.blurb: Famine in Canaan and Egypt, my soul thirsts for God, blessed are those who hunger and thirst.

themes.name: Curse
themes.blurb: Cursed is the ground, blessing and cursing set before you, Christ became a curse for us.

themes.name: Heaven
themes.blurb: The heavens and the earth, the heavens declare the glory of God, our Father in heaven, a new heaven.

themes.name: Jerusalem and Zion
themes.blurb: The city of David, Mount Zion, O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the new Jerusalem.

themes.name: Egypt
themes.blurb: Joseph in Egypt, the exodus, out of Egypt I called my son.

themes.name: Babylon
themes.blurb: Babel, the exile to Babylon, by the rivers of Babylon, Babylon the great.

themes.name: Feasts
themes.blurb: The pilgrim feasts of Israel, and Jesus at the feasts in Jerusalem.

themes.name: Births and family lines
themes.blurb: Mothers giving birth and fathers having children: Isaac, Samuel, a virgin will bear a son, and the family lines from Genesis 5 to Matthew 1.

themes.name: War and battle
themes.blurb: The LORD will fight for you, nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, war in heaven.

themes.name: Seven
themes.blurb: The seventh day, seven times, seventy weeks, seven lampstands and seven seals. A seven inside a larger count (2,172) is left out.

themes.name: Forty
themes.blurb: Forty days of rain, forty years in the wilderness, forty days of fasting and testing. A forty inside a larger count (46,500) is left out.

themes.name: Generations
themes.blurb: The account of the heavens and the earth, from generation to generation, the genealogy of Jesus.
